newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur fuel oil flat, traders relaxed.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur fuel oil flat, traders relaxed.

text.p: NWE high sulhur fuel oil drifted sideways on Thursday despite relaxed demand and soft futures, traders said.
High sulphur barges traded between $119 and $120 fob ARA and dealers said the market was supported by some healthy buying from a single trader in the ARA region.
A Scandinavian player sold a high sulphur cargo, loading in the first decade of November, to a trader. The deal was heard to have been done at $1.25 over the quoted fob high.
Another trader bought a Russian M-100 cargo, sailing on November 3-5 on the Lami, from a third trader at around $119 cif NWE. Other M-100s, with a higher water content, were valued $2 lower.
Low sulphur markets were quiet after the sale of a prompt cargo on Wednesday. "That cargo was the only aggressive offer around, and the sellers who are around now are more relaxed," a dealer said.
A sharp futures sell-off late in the day notionally knocked prices lower.
